{{Short description|American statistician}}
{{Primary sources|date=December 2021}}
'''Tim Hesterberg''' is an American statistician. He is a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] and currently works as a staff data scientist at [[Instacart]].

== Education and career==
Tim Hesterberg graduated with a B.A in mathematics from [[St. Olaf College]] and received his Ph.D. in statistics from [[Stanford University]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2012-12-17|title=Tim Hesterberg|url=https://www.niss.org/people/tim-hesterberg|access-date=2021-11-04|website=National Institute of Statistical Sciences}}</ref> He is a member of the National Institute of Statistical Sciences(NISS) and was previously on the NISS Board of Trustees. He is currently on the board of the Canadian Statistical Sciences Institute.<ref name=":0" /> Hesterberg previously worked as a senior statistician at [[Google]] as well as at [[Franklin & Marshall College|Franklin and Marshall College]], [[Pacific Gas and Electric Company|Pacific Gas & Electric Co]], and Insightful/MathSoft.<ref name=":0" /> He is currently a senior statistician at Instacart.

== Research ==
Hesterberg has contributed to statistical research by writing a textbook, articles, and a software package:
* A 2011 undergraduate student textbook titled ''Mathematical Statistics with Resampling and R''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mathematical Statistics with Resampling and R, 2nd Edition |url=https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Mathematical+Statistics+with+Resampling+and+R%2C+2nd+Edition-p-9781119416531|access-date=2021-11-04|publisher=Wiley}}</ref> 
* A 2015 article titled "What Teachers Should Know About the Bootstrap: Resampling in the Undergraduate Statistics Curriculum".<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hesterberg|first=Tim C.|date=2015-10-02|title=What Teachers Should Know About the Bootstrap: Resampling in the Undergraduate Statistics Curriculum|journal=The American Statistician|volume=69|issue=4|pages=371–386|doi=10.1080/00031305.2015.1089789|issn=0003-1305|pmc=4784504|pmid=27019512}}</ref> 
* A 2015 [[R (programming language)]] software package titled 'resample: Resampling Functions'.<ref name=":1">{{Citation|last=Hesterberg|first=Tim|title=resample: Resampling Functions|date=2015-04-12|url=https://cran.r-project.org/package=resample|access-date=2021-11-04}}</ref> It performs bootstraps, permutation tests, and other sampling refunctions, and is intended to be easy to use.<ref name=":1" />
* Scientific articles including "Bootstrap",<ref>{{Citation|last=Hesterberg|first=Tim|title=Bootstrap|date=2008-09-19|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/9780471462422.eoct392|encyclopedia=Wiley Encyclopedia of Clinical Trials|pages=1–33|editor-last=D'Agostino|editor-first=Ralph B.|place=Hoboken, NJ |publisher=John Wiley & Sons, Inc.|doi=10.1002/9780471462422.eoct392|isbn=978-0-471-46242-2|access-date=2021-11-05|editor2-last=Sullivan|editor2-first=Lisa|editor3-last=Massaro|editor3-first=Joseph|url-access=subscription}}</ref> "Least-Angle Regression and LASSO for Large Datasets",<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hesterberg|first1=Tim|last2=Choi|first2=Nam Hee|last3=Meier|first3=Lukas|last4=Fraley|first4=Chris|date=2008-01-01|title=Least angle and ℓ1 penalized regression: A review|journal=Statistics Surveys|volume=2|issue=none|doi=10.1214/08-SS035| s2cid=13967045 |issn=1935-7516|doi-access=free|arxiv=0802.0964}}</ref> and "Least Angle and L1 Penalized Regression: A Review".<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Fraley|first1=Chris|last2=Hesterberg|first2=Tim|date=March 2009|title=Least Angle Regression and LASSO for Large Datasets |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/sam.10021 |journal=Statistical Analysis and Data Mining |volume=1|issue=4|pages=251–259|doi=10.1002/sam.10021| s2cid=14050406|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
